svg.title: What the end-to-end tests run
svg.desc: run.sh drives a Docker Compose project. It talks to Nextcloud, which runs this checkout as a custom app, through occ, WebDAV and the routes of the app; it sets the scenario and the tasks of the Paperless mock, mock_server.py, which Nextcloud calls through the REST API; and it starts Chromium in the image of Playwright, which runs accessibility.mjs, keyboard.mjs, settings.mjs, files.mjs, flow.mjs and screenshots.mjs against Nextcloud. On request, Nextcloud keeps its tables in MariaDB or PostgreSQL instead of SQLite, and its files in an object store with the API of S3.
